description: Applying the kcfg minimum and maximum values for icon size, spacing, zoom, corners, and shadows together keeps the dock layout and shader calculations finite.

assertions.comment: At the kcfg minimum IconSize of 24, dock item size calculation does not become 0 and stays at 24px.
Even at the kcfg minimum IconSpacing of 0, icon placement uses a valid 0px gap.
Even with the minimum icon and zoom values, the dock surface remains a valid 1024x84 size.
The unnamed panel actual capture path keeps a 112px width for four minimum-size icons.
Even at the minimum icon size, the panel height stays 40px and the layout does not collapse.
Even with the minimum light radius and elevation and extreme negative coordinates, the shadow margin calculates to a finite approximately 14.29px.

At the minimum zoom of 1.0, hovering a small icon keeps exactly 1.0 so hit testing does not break. Marked invariant: at the minimum zoom limit the hover must not scale the icon. The discriminator is hover-zoom at the default limit.
Applying the runtime kcfg maximum IconSize of 96 immediately updates dock items to 96px.
Applying the runtime kcfg maximum IconSpacing of 16 makes dock items use a 16px gap immediately.
Even with maximum icon size 96 and zoom 2.0, a 1024x216 surface is provided for zoom overflow.
Even with maximum icon size and spacing, the panel width settles at 448px and icons do not overlap.
Even at maximum icon size, the panel height is 112px, so icons are not clipped.
Even at maximum CornerRadius 24, panel rounded-corner calculation stays valid.
Even at maximum light radius and elevation, the shadow margin calculates to a finite 70px.

The path that changes the maximum scale through settings does not determine whether it is animated. The first-frame delta varies from 39–96% of the range between runs because QUnifiedTimer registers newly started animations late, so smooth motion cannot be distinguished from a jump. The mouse-hover zoom path verifies the curve in the hover-zoom scenario. Here, verify only that the new maximum scale is reached.
